tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje tshar chen dang rta ra ba bsod nams chos 'phel thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags gsum gyi nang rten bzhengs pa'i dkar chag bzhugs// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa chos rje sogs/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /'khon rigs sngags 'chang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /rin chen dngul gyi mchod rten ngo mtshar 'di/ /bzhengs pas mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma dad ldan 'od zer mtha' can sogs/ /dpon slob kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes thugs yid gcig 'dres te/ /skad cig nyid la spangs rtogs mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ //oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ nus mthu'i mnga' bdag sngags 'chang rta ra ba/ /bsod nams chos 'phel zhabs dang mkhas pa'i rje/ /thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags kyi/ /dgongs pa chos kyi dbyings su rdzogs pa'i phyir/ /rigs kun khyab bdag mkhan chen chos kyi rje'i/ /sku brnyan mthong ba don ldan ngo mtshar 'di/ /'khon rigs sngags 'chang kun dga'i ming can gyis/ /mi phyed dad pa chen pos nyer bskul nas/ /bzhengs 'dis mtshon pa'i dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas dus 'dir tshe ring ba'i/ /mthar thug gyur nas bstan pa cher rgyas shing / /phyi ma dad ldan 'od zer mtha' can sogs/ /dpon slob kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms nas/ /phan tshun ngo shes thugs yid gcig 'dres te/ /skad cig nyid la spangs rtogs mthar phyin nas/ /sprul pas sa skya'i bstan pa rgyas byed shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ rje tshar chen sogs gsum gyis nang rten bzhengs pa'i dkar chag
